gloss: to be equipped with, to possess

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {具|そな}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be equipped with, to possess
definitions.explanation: To have something as a built-in feature or quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This product is equipped with many functions.

examples.japanese: ⟦リーダー→リーダー：24312_riidaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{資質|ししつ}→資質：07554_shishitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are few people who possess the qualities necessary for a leader.

notes:
{具|そな}える means to possess or be equipped with inherent qualities or features.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}える

KANJI DISTINCTION:
Three verbs read そなえる with different nuances:
- {具|そな}える: to possess (innate qualities)
- ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare, equip (external)
- ⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to offer (to gods/deceased)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}える: to possess talent
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}える: to meet the requirements
- ⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}える: to have the elements
Often used in the pattern 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えた + noun:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a talented person
- ⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{具|そな}えた⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: a product equipped with features

This form is relatively formal/literary.
